data.name: Vallarasu
data.gender_notes: Vallarasu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lord Vallarasu is the God of Wisdom, Knowledge and Wealth. He is believed to bestow the blessings of wisdom and knowledge upon his devotees. He is also known as the protector of the Vedas and the God of learning. The name Vallarasu carries the meaning “God of Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil. Parents who choose Vallarasu usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the wisdom and knowledge that comes with spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Vallarasu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vallarasu total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
